news.headline: Bears rule out CB Kyler Gordon; RB Kyle Monangai cleared to return
news.detail: The Bears will be without nickel corner Kyler Gordon when they host the Saints, while running back Kyle Monangai, wide receiver Luther Burden III and defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons are expected to play.
